title: Parameters

order_ids.description: A comma-separated list of order's identifiers
order_ids.title: Order IDs

order_references_for_customer.description: A comma-separated list of order references for customer
order_references_for_customer.title: Customer Order References

order_references_for_seller.description: A comma-separated list of order references for seller
order_references_for_seller.title: Seller Order References

order_state_codes.description: A comma-separated list of order state's codes
order_state_codes.title: Order State Codes

channel_codes.description: A comma-separated list of channel codes
channel_codes.title: Channel Codes

only_null_channel.description: Return only orders without channel. If true, ignore the channel_codes
only_null_channel.title: Only Null Channel

start_update_date.description: Start update date for filtering. Mirakl will subtract a time delta to ensure no orders are missed due to network and/or software latency.
start_update_date.title: Start Update Date

has_incident.description: If true returns only orders with incidents in progress, if false returns orders without incidents in progress. If not provided, all orders with or without incident will be returned
has_incident.title: Has Incident

order_tax_mode.description:
Please note: If the taxes are not specified, the prices with mode TAX_EXCLUDED and with mode TAX_INCLUDED will return the same amounts.
Possible values:
  • TAX_EXCLUDED: the price fields (price, unit price, shipping price, cancellation amount, refund amount and order total prices) do not include taxes.
  • TAX_INCLUDED: the price fields include the tax amount.
  • If this query parameter is not specified, the default order tax mode of the platform is used.
order_tax_mode.title: Order Tax Mode

shop_id.description: Use this parameter when your user has access to several shops. If not specified, the shop_id from your default shop will be used.
shop_id.title: Shop ID

description: Query parameters for filtering, searching, and paginating orders.
